name: Tekumo, Inc.
summary: Tekumo, Inc. provides a service delivery platform for the onsite installation, monitoring, and maintenance of technology systems and smart connected devices in the United States. The company offers TekumoPRO, a platform that connects enterprises, retailers, and OEM’s with local skilled resources to install and maintain technology systems; and TekumoSMART that delivers a service platform for smart connected devices for installing, monitoring, and managing sensors, devices gateways, hubs, and data for various verticals, including multiple dwelling units, quick service restaurants, assisted living, retail, hospitality, utilities, builders, insurance, and facility managers with 24/7 onsite support. It also provides TekumoIQ, which provides real-time data from all connected assets accessible through Tekumo dashboards or directly delivered into end user ecosystem; and TekumoMS, a solution that provides direct managed support, sourcing, and project management for enterprise partners. Tekumo, Inc. is based in Colorado Springs, Colorado.
